  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/visibilitat-costa.json]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/visibilitat-perimetre.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json,numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/visibilitat-costa.json').read_text())
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':13,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(5,1,figsize=(9.5,10.0),sharex=True,sharey=True)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.13,right=.77,bottom=.09,top=.95,hspace=.47)
ids=['original','tancament-50m','tancament-100m','tancament-150m','tancament-250m']
titles=['A · Coberta original','B · Buffers: +50 m i −50 m','C · Buffers: +100 m i −100 m',
        'D · Recinte: +150 m i −150 m','E · Buffers: +250 m i −250 m']
colours=['#ced5da','#f1d2a0','#eebcc5','#d9c6ee','#b4dadd']
reference=np.array(d['original_sector']['coordinates'][0])[:,:2]/1000
rows=[next(row for row in d['geometry_alternatives'] if row['id']==key) for key in ids]
for ax,row,title,colour in zip(axes,rows,titles,colours):
    g=row['geometry'];parts=g['coordinates'] if g['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [g['coordinates']]
    for rings in parts:
        ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(rings[0])[:,:2]/1000,facecolor=colour,edgecolor='#424242',lw=.8))
        for hole in rings[1:]:ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(hole)[:,:2]/1000,facecolor='white',edgecolor='#777777',lw=.5))
    ax.plot(reference[:,0],reference[:,1],color='#444444',lw=.7,ls='--')
    ax.set(xlim=(345.2,350),ylim=(4551.7,4553.0),aspect='equal')
    ax.set_yticks([4552,4553]);ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False,style='plain');ax.tick_params(labelsize=12)
    ax.set_title(title,loc='left',fontsize=13,weight='bold',pad=8)
    area=f"{row['area_m2']/10000:.2f}".replace('.',',')
    outside=f"{row['added_outside_original_perimeter_m2']/10000:.2f}".replace('.',',')
    ax.text(1.04,.68,f"{area} ha · {row['holes']} forats",transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=12,va='center')
    ax.text(1.04,.27,f"Exterior afegit:\n{outside} ha",transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=12,va='center')
axes[-1].set_xlabel('Est UTM (km)');axes[-1].set_xticks([346,347,348,349])
fig.text(.015,.53,'Nord UTM (km)',rotation=90,va='center',fontsize=13)
fig.text(.5,.025,'Línia discontínua: contorn exterior original · Mateixa escala als cinc panells',ha='center',fontsize=12)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/visibilitat-perimetre.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
